title: Context and memory in an agent

items.stem: On Monday a student told your makerspace assistant about a wrist injury. Your program saved nothing when that chat ended. On Tuesday the student opens a new chat. What does the model know about Monday?

options.text: Everything said on Monday, since the model keeps all past chats
A short summary that the model wrote itself at the end of Monday
Nothing, because the new chat starts with an empty context window
Only the injury, since important facts are stored in its weights

items.stem: In one run, the system prompt, tool definitions and question total 1,600 tokens, and the program resends everything on each model call. The model makes a 50-token tool request, and a 200-token result comes back. It then makes another 50-token request, and a 1,000-token result comes back. It then writes its final answer. Counting only input, how many tokens did the model read across all three of its calls in this run?
Your team has a 400-page set of machine manuals, and the model's context window is large enough to hold all of it. Which design best fits your small model budget?

options.text: Put all the manuals in the system prompt, so every answer has the facts
Summarise the manuals into one page and use that page for every answer
Give a search tool that returns a few passages, and add only those
Save the manuals as notes so the model memorises them between sessions

items.stem: In one run the tool results are all tiny, yet the model's 20th call costs more than its 2nd call. In one sentence, why?

Your assistant needs two facts: a student's completed safety trainings, and tomorrow's free time slots on the 3D printer. Which one should be saved between sessions, and why is the other one not saved?
